# ourapps.app

> Private installer for apps people build for friends and family. Developers sign in with GitHub, register apps, create share links; friends install from the links on iPhone (Apple Ad Hoc) or Android (APK) without any store.

- [API reference for agents](https://ourapps.app/agents.md): every endpoint, auth with `Authorization: Bearer oa_...`, workflows.
- [Repository contract](https://ourapps.app/contract.md): what an app's GitHub repository must publish and the two calls its workflow makes.
- Console: https://ourapps.app/dev (sign in with GitHub). API keys and agent prompts: https://ourapps.app/dev/agents.
